subject: MSA preflight — propose staggered short check-ins for onboarding week
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@heliohealth.com>, Danielle Ortiz <dani.ortiz@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: MSA preflight — propose staggered short check-ins for onboarding week

Hi Sara / Danielle,

Thanks again for moving quickly on the MSA redlines. To keep momentum while minimizing calendar churn on your side, we propose breaking the usual 90-minute preflight into three focused 25–30 minute checkpoints across the week of July 12th:

- Day 1: Contract scope and data residency items (25 min)
- Day 3: Security & SOC2 evidence follow-up (30 min)
- Day 5: Rollout timeline + implementation dependencies (25 min)

Benefits: shorter meetings are easier for cross-functional attendees, let us tackle redlines incrementally, and we can produce concrete action items after each checkpoint.

Proposed time windows (all PT):
- Jul 12, 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Jul 14, 11:00–11:30 or 15:30–16:00
- Jul 16, 09:30–10:00 or 13:00–13:30

I attached a short agenda and a lightweight MSA question tracker so we can pre-assign owners. Can you share availability for those windows (or propose alternatives)?

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Lead, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0147
From: Sara Patel <sara@heliohealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Ortiz <dani.ortiz@heliohealth.com>, procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MSA preflight — propose staggered short check-ins for onboarding week

Hi Tessa — thanks for the proposal. The staggered approach makes sense. A couple of asks from procurement/legal here:

- We have a standing leadership sync on Jul 12 at 10:00 PT, so we can't take the first slot then. Could we shift to 14:00–14:30 on Jul 12 (that works for our legal lead)?
- For Jul 14, 11:00 clashes with a vendor review; 15:30–16:00 is fine.
- Jul 16 at 09:30 is tight for our implementation PMs — is 13:00–13:30 still open?

Also, Danielle would like the final checkpoint to include a quick walk through any outstanding redlines that require sign-off so legal can prep approvals. Is it possible to send the updated tracker 48 hours before each checkpoint?

Sara
Procurement Manager
HelioHealth
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: MSA preflight — propose staggered short check-ins for onboarding week

Thanks Sara — that works. Confirming per your asks:

- Jul 12, 14:00–14:30 PT — Contract scope & data residency
- Jul 14, 15:30–16:00 PT — Security & SOC2 evidence follow-up
- Jul 16, 13:00–13:30 PT — Rollout timeline + redline sign-off (legal to prep)

Rishi and I will update the tracker and circulate a one-page prep doc 48 hours before each checkpoint. I'll include a short note on any redlines that will need explicit legal approval during the Jul 16 checkpoint.

Attachments: onboarding-checklist-30min-agenda.docx, MSA-questions-v1.xlsx

If procurement wants a single invite with three events, say so and we will send a single series; otherwise we'll send three separate invites.

Laura
